purpose: Compare eight economically motivated wheel settings; choose using 2023 only, then freeze before requesting 2026 performance data.
selection: Highest 2023 net account return; ties resolved by smaller drawdown, then configuration ID. No reselection using later periods.
bias_limits: AMZN and the 2023–2025 path were already examined; historical redesign remains exploratory.
Single surviving stock, a bounded strike grid, daily quote timing and simulated assignment remain limitations.
A later historical sample inspected only after rule freeze is a held-out historical test, not a prospective live experiment.
data_boundary: Retain the same monthly $40–$300 strike grid. No new underlying search, leverage, cash-yield assumption, or parameter expansion based on test results.
